findings.title: Late binding still imports a success-settlement predicate without defining its cleanup-independent meaning for the new profile
evidence: MB7 requires a sealed current allocated/input/success-settlement proof, and MB8 publishes readiness before/with settlement; the document explicitly connects the approved legacy contract but gives no explicit replacement definition for this predicate.

Legacy Requirements9 at b191b466 doc/requirements/issue-43-requirements.md:87-105 requires current Exited success plus verified profile-required settlement and explicitly rejects unknown cleanup. Legacy binding mechanics:619-644 similarly requires full cleanup on lost normal delivery.

MB6 says cleanup remains best effort and separate from work outcome, but does not state whether unknown/leftovers alone may prevent the factual late binder/readiness. The new managed execution requirements explicitly supersede conflicting ownership-only policy and prohibit cleanup-only whole-Task blockage (agent-execution-requirements.md:89-106,188-200).

Current actual Native terminal transaction classifies OwnedTerminal from current private Unit authority and persists known work/Session/receipt before cleanup (state/execution/native_results.rs:386-418,449-503; execution/native.rs:1326-1351). This is not legacy physical full settlement.
findings.causal_rationale: A legitimate current invocation completes successfully after its Engine start-result delivery is dropped, while a detached descendant remains or the process/Docker cleanup observation stays unknown. An implementation following the imported legacy success-settlement condition cannot bind the absent Session, so the real Driver remains held solely by best-effort cleanup. Calling the same DTO a settlement proof instead would silently assert unimplemented legacy ownership/settlement. The requirements must choose the actual new-profile predicate rather than leave these two readings.
findings.requested_change: Define the managed late proof explicitly: genuine private phase owner/prepared/admitted/actually consumed input and exact current known successful owned Native terminal under the original frame/instance, plus any genuine result/logical finalization evidence needed for factual binding. State exactly which old physical-settlement/death predicate is superseded for this profile, that cleanup unknown/leftovers alone neither creates authority nor blocks eligible factual binding/progress, and keep actual unknown work, ambiguous input/current proof, irreversible external-effect uncertainty and stale/recovery authority as holds. Do not weaken private #19 input proof or accept raw receipt IDs.
causal_controls_not_executed: Actual owned registered invocation finishes after lost start delivery with genuine input/terminal proof and forced cleanup Unknown/Leftovers. Real active Driver late binder advances only Workflow/audit once; Task/Session/full locks remain unchanged and no second input is emitted.

Same fixture with Unknown work, HistoricalDraft, wrong input/marker/instance or ambiguous external operation still holds with zero binding writes. Neither a cleanup label nor a public NativeResultReceipt can mint the private proof.

findings.title: State the normal pre-input/pre-ACK private proof state explicitly
evidence: MB3 refers jointly to preparation/admission/consumption pair for both normal and late paths; MB4 allows Starting lifecycle advancement but does not explicitly say actual consumed input or acknowledgment is not required for factual normal binding.
The imported approved mechanics at b191b466:180-187 explicitly permits private validated Starting preparation before ACK without delivery assertion.

Actual NativeSessions returns Launched after Core is spawned (execution/native.rs:406-425,513-518); its invocation initially has NotDispatched, no input effect/thread/turn (native.rs:905-940), and actual input reservation/ACK occur later. An ordinary legal normal return can precede those facts.
findings.causal_rationale: This is covered by the referenced legacy state contract, so it is a clarification rather than an independently demonstrated blocking contradiction. Making the distinction explicit avoids waiting for consumption just to record a legally allocated Starting Session, or fabricating consumed evidence to pass binding.
findings.requested_change: Explicitly allow normal factual binding from the genuine validated/prepared private owner/pair in its permitted pre-input/pre-ACK state, while requiring actual correlated consumed input/current successful terminal for the lost-return late path. Neither path grants input delivery, completion or success from binding.
causal_controls_not_executed: Actual managed adapter returns before any native input/ACK; binder records its genuine Starting private owner with zero delivery/success claim. Late path using that same NotDispatched owner is refused.
